title: FlashAttention
brief: Write the tiled forward pass with an online softmax, and never materialize a score matrix.
hints: Keep m, l, and acc in float32. The running denominator sums thousands of exponentials.
On a new tile maximum, rescale both l and acc by exp(m_old - m_new) before adding.
Skip whole key tiles past the causal diagonal instead of masking them after the fact.
kv_head = head // kv_group lets the kernel share KV heads without the caller duplicating them.
